paite: Huan, Israel a neih tengteng toh a pawta, Beer-seba a tunga, a pa Isaak Pathian kiangah kithoihnate alan.
english: Israel traveled with all that he had, and came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices to the God of his father, Isaac.

paite: Huan, Pathianin jana a mangin Israel a houpih a, Jakob, Jakob, achia.
english: God spoke to Israel in the visions of the night, and said, “Jacob, Jacob!” He said, “Here I am.”

paite: Huan, aman, hiaiah ka om, achia. Huan, aman, kei Pathian, na Pathian, ka hi: Aigupta gama hoh suk lau ken; huailaiah chi thupi takin ka honbawl ding hi:
english: He said, “I am God, the God of your father. Don’t be afraid to go down into Egypt, for there I will make of you a great nation.

paite: Aigupta gamah na kiangah ka hong dinga; huan, ka honpi tou nawn ngeingei ding: huan, Joseph in na sih hun chiangin na mit a honbawl sak ding hi, achia.
english: I will go down with you into Egypt. I will also surely bring you up again. Joseph will close your eyes.”

paite: Huchiin, Jakob Beer-seba akipanin a pawta: Israel taten a pa uh Jakob leh a ta neu chikchik te uhleh a jite uh tuanna dinga Pharo in kangtalai a khak te ah a tuang sak uhi.
english: Jacob rose up from Beersheba, and the sons of Israel carried Jacob, their father, their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.

paite: Huchiin, Jakob leh a suante tengteng in kanan gama a lamkhiak uh, a gante u leh a vante uh, a tawi ua, Aigupta gama tungta uh:
english: They took their livestock, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt—Jacob, and all his seed with him,

paite: A tapa te, a tupa te, a tanu te, a tunu te, a suante tengteng, Aigupta gamah a lut pihta hi.
english: his sons, and his sons’ sons with him, his daughters, and his sons’ daughters, and he brought all his seed with him into Egypt.

paite: Huan, hiaite Israel suan Aigupta gama lut, Jakob leh a tapate min ahi: Reuben Jakob ta masa.
english: These are the names of the children of Israel, who came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn.

paite: Huan, Reuben tapate Hanok te, Pallu te, Hezron te, Karmi te ahi uhi.
english: The sons of Reuben: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

paite: Huan, Simeon tapate Jemuel te, Jamin te, Ohad te, Jakin te, Johat te, Kanan numei laka a tapa Saula te ahi uhi.
english: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman.

paite: Huan, Levi tapa te Gerson te, Kohat te, Merari te, ahi uhi.
english: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

paite: Huan, Juda tapate Er te, Onan te, Sela te, Perez te, Zerah te ahi ua: Er leh Onan bel Kanan gamah a sita ua. Perez tapate Hezrun leh Hamul ahi uhi.
english: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, and Zerah; but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. The sons of Perez were Hezron and Hamul.

paite: Huan, Issakar tapate Tola te, Puva te, Ioba te, Simron te ahi uhi.
english: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puvah, Iob, and Shimron.

paite: Huan, Zebulun tapate Sered te, Elon te, Jhaleel te ahi uhi.
english: The sons of Zebulun: Sered, Elon, and Jahleel.

paite: Huaite tengteng Lea tapa, a tanu Dina toh, Padanaram gama Jakob a neihsakte ahi uhi: a tapate leh a tanute tengteng sawm thum leh thum ahi uhi.
english: These are the sons of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob in Paddan Aram, with his daughter Dinah. All the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty-three.

paite: Huan, Gad tapate Ziphion te, Haggi te, Suni te, Ezbon te, Eri te, Arobdi te, Areli te ahi uh.
english: The sons of Gad: Ziphion, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, and Areli.

paite: Huan, Aser tapate Imna te, Isva te, Isvi te, Beria te ahi uh, a sanggamnu uh Sera toh: huan, Beria tapate Beber leh Malkiel ahi uhi.
english: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, and Serah their sister. The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel.

paite: Huaite Zilpai Laban in a tanu Lea kianga a piakpa tapa te ahi ua, huaite Jakob a neihsaka, mi sawm leh gukte.
english: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah, his daughter, and these she bore to Jacob, even sixteen souls.

paite: Huan, Jakob ji Rakil tapate Joseph leh Benjamin ahi uhi.
english: The sons of Rachel, Jacob’s wife: Joseph and Benjamin.

paite: Huan, Joseph in Aigupta gamah tapa Manassi leh Ephraim a neia, huai mite On kho siampu Potipher tanu Asenathin amah a neihsak ahi.
english: To Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, bore to him.

paite: Huan, Benjamin in tapate Bel te, Bekor te, Asbel te, Ger te, Naaman te, Ehi te, Ros te, Muppim te, Huppin te, Ardi te ahi uhi.
english: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, and Ard.

paite: Huaite Rakil tapa Jakob a neihsakte ahi uh: a vek un sawm leh li ahi uh.
english: These are the sons of Rachel, who were born to Jacob: all the souls were fourteen.

paite: Huan, Dan tapa Husim ahi.
english: The son of Dan: Hushim.

paite: Huan, Naphtali tapate Jahzeel te, guni te, Jezer te, Sillem te ahi uh.
english: The sons of Naphtali: Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem.

paite: Huaite Bilhai Laban in a tanu Rakil kianga a piakpa tapate ahi uh, huaite Jakob a neihsaka: a vek un sagih ahi uh.
english: These are the sons of Bilhah, whom Laban gave to Rachel, his daughter, and these she bore to Jacob: all the souls were seven.

paite: Jakob tapate jite simlouh in Jakob kianga Aigupta gama lut a khala pawt tengteng a vek un sawm guk leh guk ahi uhi;
english: All the souls who came with Jacob into Egypt, who were his direct descendants, besides Jacob’s sons’ wives, all the souls were sixty-six.

paite: Huan, Joseph in Aigupta gama tapa a neihte nih ahi ua: Jakob inkuanpihte tengteng, Aigupta gam a lutte, sawm sagih ahi uh.
english: The sons of Joseph, who were born to him in Egypt, were two souls. All the souls of the house of Jacob, who came into Egypt, were seventy.

paite: Huan, Jakob in, Gosen gam lam lampi na nakawk muh dingin, Juda bel Joseph kiangah a hoh masa saka;
english: He sent Judah before him to Joseph, to show the way before him to Goshen, and they came into the land of Goshen.

paite: Huchiin, Gosen gamah lutta uh. Huan, Joseph in a kangtalai a bawlkhola, Gosen gamah a pa dawn dingin a hih tou hi; huan, a kiangah a kigena, a ngawnga kunin a kap nilouh hi.
english: Joseph prepared his chariot, and went up to meet Israel, his father, in Goshen. He presented himself to him, and fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.

paite: Huan, Israel in, Joseph kiangah, dam dama na oma, na mel ka muh nawn jiak in tun jaw ut leh sita leng le, achia.
english: Israel said to Joseph, “Now let me die, since I have seen your face, that you are still alive.”

paite: Huan, Joseph in, a unaute leh apa inkuanpihte kiangah kava hoh tou dia, Pharo ka hilh dinga, a kiangah, ka unaute leh ka pa inkuanpihte, huai Kanan gama omte, ka kiangah a hongtung ta uh;
english: Joseph said to his brothers, and to his father’s house, “I will go up, and speak with Pharaoh, and will tell him, ‘My brothers, and my father’s house, who were in the land of Canaan, have come to me.

paite: Amaute ganvulmi ahihjiakun belam chingmite ahi uh; a belam honte u leh a bawng honte uh leh a neih tengteng uh ahonpo vek hi, chiin, kava gen ding.
english: These men are shepherds, for they have been keepers of livestock, and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.’

paite: Huan, hichi ahi dinga, Pharo in nou a honsapa, bang nasem na hi ua? a honchih hun chiangin,Nou, na sikha te, honsuangte akipan, naupang chik ka hihlai ua kipan in tu tanin gan vulmi ka hi uh, na chi ding uh: huchiin, Gosen gamah na om thei ding uhi, achia. Belam chingmite himhim lah Aigupta mite kih lamtak ahi ngal ua.
english: It will happen, when Pharaoh summons you, and will say, ‘What is your occupation?’

paite: Nou, na sikha te, honsuangte akipan, naupang chik ka hihlai ua kipan in tu tanin gan vulmi ka hi uh, na chi ding uh: huchiin, Gosen gamah na om thei ding uhi, achia. Belam chingmite himhim lah Aigupta mite kih lamtak ahi ngal ua.
english: that you shall say, ‘Your servants have been keepers of livestock from our youth even until now, both we, and our fathers:’ that you may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination to the Egyptians.”
